'''Catlia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Catlia system/Legends|Catlia system]], in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected by the [[Phalanx Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the planet [[Cormit/Legends|Cormit]]. Catlia was an outlying colony of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was home to one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the resident Ruling Family employed hives of the sentient [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as a work force. As a result, the Family [[Chiss civil conflict|fell]] out of power that year, and its members became [[Joiner]]s&mdash;a part of the Killiks' hive-mind.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Catlia was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square G-8.<ref name="TEA" />
